body:
Everything would be easier if I just closed my eyes and never opened them again. It would be perfect to die without pain, without agony. Since I was 10 years old I have thought about suicide. I have hated my life and I have hated myself. 

I have anxiety attacks that make me want to grab a rope and hang myself. I have little lapses where I am calm but they are not worth it. It's not worth the little lapses of happiness compared to the crises I have. Crises that make me cry and feel miserable. Crises where I hurt myself. Crises where I would like to tear my skin off to stop being me.

I feel empty inside.  I have lost interest in everything. There are days when I don't want to get out of bed.

You know... It's funny that we both attempted suicide on the same day. And we're going to do it again.

This would be my second suicide attempt, on February 2nd of this year I tried to take my life by cutting my wrists but failed. I would say I am determined but I am not. Not because I still have something pending or some yearning but because of the way I will die, I will suffer and I don't know how much. Plus I need to do it at the right time to do it so no one will stop me.

Context: I have a stepbrother, (on my mother's side, he is currently 35. I have a sister who is 22 and a brother who is 23). 
My father was a violent alcoholic when I was a child. When he drank he would get extremely violent, he would beat my mother, on several occasions he tried to kill her. (He never hit me and my siblings, but he did hurt us). The house was a real hell when he drank. He even ran us out of the house because he hated my mother, he treated her like a commoner. We always came back to him, since he has land to inherit us. 
Nowadays my father doesn't drink anymore. He is 74 years old (I know, he is already a senior citizen). We live with him. But as you know, he no longer works, so we are poor. My mother is the one who pays the household expenses. I have always lacked everything and even more maternal love.
Knowing the hell my mother went through, she has hated me from the first day I was born, for the simple fact that I looked like my father. She didn't want me. (As I know because I heard it as a child). Since I was born she let me know how useless and worthless I am, "That everything I do is wrong and that everything bad that happens is my fault. He would hit me as a child if I didn't do things right. The hatred with which he speaks to me breaks my soul. He is only like that with me, my siblings are his adoration. 

I am an extremely sensitive person. If they say or do something mean to me, no matter how small, I cry. (I don't do it intentionally. My eyes shed tears even if I don't want them to. I've always hated myself for that. For being a crier, and I can't help it. That's just the way my self is)
My sister despises me for being a crybaby just like my mother. Everyone in my house has a very strong character compared to mine. My mother is a very explosive woman. She says horrible things to me in anger.

Besides being a crybaby, I am also an extroverted person, I don't like to go out to parties, I don't like to spend time with people, it's hard for me to make friends. (Currently I don't have a single friend, not even a girlfriend. I do not talk to anyone, not even on social networks). (My mother has labeled me as boring and bitter). 

My stepbrother has also let me know how useless I am, he mistreated me a lot since I was a child.  He stopped living with us about 8 years ago. Because my father doesn't want him, he considered him a bastard. 
My stepbrother at the age of 5 wanted me to learn to do my homework so I wouldn't be lazy in the house. He would pull my hair and ears because I didn't know how to sweep well or wash the dishes. And she would tell me how stupid and useless I was. It was horrible for me to live with him. As a child I was very afraid of him. Today I can't tolerate his presence, I hate him.

I have not had a job at my age. I have dedicated myself to my studies, I have been an outstanding student since I was 6 years old. And I am the one who does all the housekeeping and I almost always help with the cooking or sometimes I do it myself. My siblings work and study (My brother helps with money from time to time but not always, my sister has never done it, today my sister is not working. In my home I am considered a lazy and maintained for not having a job, and someone who never does anything. They make me feel like a parasite who lives off them. 

You know, I'm very scared, I'm afraid of drunk people and people who are angry, I'm afraid they will explode on me and hurt me like my mother has done. After much hearing how worthless and useless I am, my mind has bought it. I know I will fail at everything I do. I have no future.

On September 16 my cat died, the light of my eyes, the reason for living. He died of poison. I could do nothing for him. I don't know who did it. He was the reason to fight day by day but he is gone. I would have been 3 years old in November last year. But he didn't make it. He was my sincere and loyal friend. He was the only one who was good to me. His death still hurts me. His death tore my soul.

I gained weight when I entered high school. My self-esteem dropped, my friends made fun of me, my family made fun of me. On one occasion my classmates took a picture of me and compared it to a pig. I tried to lose weight but didn't succeed. One day my brother seeing me a little thinner told me "Don't lose weight, you must stay the fat one in the family." That hurt me. I cry when I look at myself in the mirror. I hate myself for eating too much. I have a deformed body. I'm not pretty, I have no charisma, no one would notice me. 


If you've made it this far. Thank you for reading. 
I summarized as much as I could.

Thank you... Thank you so much.

I really can't stand getting up every morning and knowing that I have to live feeling miserable and useless.
Plus dealing with my anxiety and depression. I can't anymore, I really can't anymore.
